name: application-availability-grid
title: Availability Grid
description: Bookable time-slot grid with free/busy/selected button states across a row of days, driven by a typed days/times/slots prop contract.
useWhen: Letting a user pick a bookable time slot across several days, such as scheduling a meeting or appointment.
Some slots must be shown as unavailable (busy) and excluded from selection, distinct from free slots.
A compact grid view of the week's availability is preferable to paging through single days.
avoidWhen: You need a full month calendar with events — use the Event Calendar component instead.
Only a single day's slots need to be shown — a simple vertical list of times may be clearer than a grid.
Slots don't have a fixed grid cadence (e.g. arbitrary-length events) — a calendar view fits variable-duration events better.
responsiveBehavior: The day columns use a CSS grid that shares available width evenly; on narrow viewports, reduce the number of visible days or allow the grid to scroll horizontally rather than shrinking cells below a legible size.
accessibility: Each slot button carries a composed aria-label naming the day, time, and current state, since the grid layout alone doesn't convey that combination to screen readers.
Busy slots are real disabled buttons, not just visually dimmed clickable elements, so they're correctly skipped in keyboard navigation.
Selected slots use aria-pressed in addition to their filled background, and the bottom legend restates all three states with both a swatch and a text label.

variants.title: Availability Grid
variants.description: Week-view time-slot grid with day column headers, hour row labels, free/busy/selected button states, and a bottom legend.
accessibility: Busy slots are disabled buttons; free and selected states are distinguished by both fill color and text label, not color alone.

variants.title: Availability Grid (Dark)
variants.description: Bookable time-slot grid adapted for dark surfaces with the same day/time-header, slot-state, and legend structure.
accessibility: Free/busy/selected fill colors and their text labels must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
